schema_version: 1
layers:
  domain: internal/domain
  use_cases: internal/usecase
  inbound_http: internal/transport/http
  outbound_postgres: internal/infrastructure/persistence/postgres
  outbound_services: [internal/infrastructure/http/student, internal/infrastructure/http/course, internal/infrastructure/http/aiprompt, internal/infrastructure/http/tzplanner]
  outbound_messaging: internal/infrastructure/messaging/nats
  composition_root: cmd/ms-go-learning-planner/main.go
invariants:
  - Planner owns the learning target/prerequisite graph and Course design/generation workflow, not canonical Course rows or Student state
  - no separate Knowledge Tree service exists in the current architecture
  - Course remains the hierarchy root; no snapshot node is inserted between Course and Module
  - Student self-assessment is a hypothesis and never directly skips a target
  - deterministic graph closure and ordering precede any future model enrichment
  - graph readiness is read-only, selects only closed exact published goals, and never creates content or prospective Course/path/lesson identities
  - a Teacher onboarding handoff is an immutable historical non-executable admission receipt; it creates no S9 effect, and S9 must re-read and atomically reserve Student state before effects
  - CourseFingerprint is canonical, versioned, student-neutral, and order-stable
  - Course persistence and Student assignment are synchronous idempotent commands
  - Student read projections and Planner-owned Student writes use distinct credentials
  - active planning claims are renewed between bounded downstream operations
  - every exact-path REPLAN or NO_GAP body, expected path version, identities, private planned outcome, and semantic hash are durably immutable before the Student PUT; a checkpointed retry never rereads path state or rebuilds the command, and public result fields stay unset until confirmed success
  - INITIAL requests have no caller-supplied path; Student allocates one idempotently and Planner checkpoints the returned ID before later side effects
  - REPLAN requires one exact Student-owned learning_path_id and never follows the selected or primary singular projection
  - Student owns progress-safe exact-path reconciliation; Planner sends desired Course identity, ordered items, and policy reasons only
  - NO_GAP idempotently completes only the exact requested Learning Path; a new-path NO_GAP creates no path
  - terminal planning state and its outbox event commit atomically; publication is at least once
  - a delivered Student 409 for a checkpointed exact-path command is terminal LEARNING_PATH_COMMAND_CONFLICT, while transport ambiguity retries only the identical checkpoint
  - transport is inbound-only and HTTP contours are fail-closed
  - infrastructure is outbound-only and fail-closed to declared clients and PostgreSQL
  - mixed inbound and outbound layer directories are forbidden
  - Practice owns the frozen runtime snapshot; Planner stores only its immutable idempotency receipt.
  - Practice route resolution never generates content; material generation occurs only on explicit ensure.
  - Planner owns the durable path-backed project authoring flow, while TZ Planner owns verified READY artifacts and Practice owns published revisions and explicit runtime Start.
  - project READY never implies publication and PUBLISHED never calls Practice Start or Sandbox.
  - project confirmation, TZ locator, READY digests, and explicit publication receipt are immutable checkpoints guarded by version CAS and a worker claim.
  - project authoring freezes the authoritative Student onboarding version plus a digest over only derived locale and canonical desired stack codes; both owner profile and path provenance are revalidated before authoring, READY, and publication.
  - domain and usecase do not import transport, infrastructure, or frameworks
cross_service_contracts:
  - ms-go-student owns onboarding, mastery, Course assignments, and progress
  - ms-go-course owns Course hierarchy, CourseFingerprint uniqueness, and content lifecycle
  - ms-go-teacher-agent owns runtime pedagogical action and is not a Course planner
  - ms-go-ai-prompt owns typed confidential model execution and never becomes Course source of truth
  - ms-go-practice-task-orchestrator owns task instances and frozen student-task learning snapshots
  - ms-go-tz-planner owns project authoring jobs, verified artifacts, and private Practice staging
